---
title: "iqtree_output"
output: html_notebook
---


```{r}
library(ggtree)
library(treeio)
library(ggrepel)
```
```{r}
tree <- read.iqtree("final.min4.phy.varsites.phy.treefile")
metadata <- read.csv("final_popmap.csv")
```

```{r}
tree1 <- ggtree(tree, branch.length = "none") %<+% metadata
tree1
```
```{r}
tree1 + geom_tippoint(aes(color = pop), size = 2.5) + xlim(0, 21) + geom_nodelab(aes(subset = !is.na(UFboot) & UFboot > 90, label = UFboot),
  hjust = -0.2, size = 2.5, fontface = "bold"
) +
  geom_nodelab(aes(subset = !is.na(UFboot) & UFboot < 90, label = UFboot),
    hjust = -0.2, size = 2
)+
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#04A3BDFF", "#F0BE3DFF", "#931E18FF", "#DA7901FF", "#247D3FFF", "#20235BFF", "#C0392BFF")) +
  labs(colour = "Population") +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.2,0.9), legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"), 
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)   
  )
```

```{r}
ggsave(filename = "tree.png", width = 8 , height = 11)
ggsave(filename = "tree.pdf", width = 8 , height = 11)
```
